title: Natural-movie parcel-response encoding
scientific_question: Can a frozen stimulus-to-brain encoder predict measured parcel responses for complete unseen films/episodes in the four recorded people, beyond nuisance/time structure, under explicitly declared feature and hemodynamic context?
primary_outputs: Measured BOLD time series for each source participant and ordered native parcel at each eligible held-out TR, not the published challenge score or output of another model.

recording_contract.neural: Organizer README specifies per-subject HDF5, with per-segment arrays (samples, 1000 parcels); pinned TRIBE loader reads HDF5 keys and transposes into parcel-by-time. Neural array payload not inspected.
recording_contract.labels: Stimulus movie/episode/chunk IDs, timestamped transcript rows and video/audio streams; neural responses are targets for encoding. Test sample counts are not test response values.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Organizer documentation and pinned loader specify TR=1.49 seconds; transcript rows cover 1.49-second windows. Hemodynamic lag and temporal buffering must be fixed.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Four people: sub-01, sub-02, sub-03, sub-05. Repeated movie runs and segments are nested within these people.
recording_contract.evidence: Public dataset git tree/README and one actual annex-pointer text inspected; four relevant TRIBE loader/configuration files inspected as text. Not a data payload or reference run.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Permitted frozen audio, visual and language feature families aligned to the source TR, with extractor/version/exposure and left/right context documented.
Training neural responses and native participant parcel order only; test sample count/shape may be public but held response values remain private.
A named narrower Movie10 transcript-input condition may be retained as development scope if its exact source and case roster are recovered.
forbidden_inputs: Held-film neural response values, answer-bearing target files, source result tables or memorized challenge submissions.
Repeated viewings/chunks of a held film in training; transforms fit on held response data.
Undeclared feature lookahead or hemodynamic context crossing held boundaries.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Known source participants are sub-01,sub-02,sub-03,sub-05. Exact film/segment/run/TR and target parcel roster is not delivered; the legacy count16 is a proposal, not an authenticated emitted case list.
allowed_inputs.split: Prospective whole-film/episode grouping, including repeated viewings across all people, with frozen HRF/feature-context guard bands and training-only fitting. The manifest supplies a transcript-development scope but not a verified current split.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Legacy declaration:16 cases,four films,four people,1000 parcels,56 files per view and32 outputs. No payload, independently scored submission or complete multimodal source coverage is established. Conditions do not increase registration count.

biological_unit: Four people(sub-01,sub-02,sub-03,sub-05); films/segments/TRs/parcels are repeated observations and not additional people.
case_definition: A participant×whole held film/episode packet with all eligible time points and1000 native parcels. Manifest proposal covers four people×four films=16 development cases only.

split.policy: Prospective whole-film/episode grouping, including repeated viewings across all people, with frozen HRF/feature-context guard bands and training-only fitting. The manifest supplies a transcript-development scope but not a verified current split.
split.coverage: Legacy declaration:16 cases,four films,four people,1000 parcels,56 files per view and32 outputs. No payload, independently scored submission or complete multimodal source coverage is established. Conditions do not increase registration count.

reference.role: Organizer documented encoding baseline; directory inventory checked, baseline source/execution not yet qualified.

primary.name: Mean held-film parcel Pearson correlation under a frozen OOD-style estimator
primary.aggregation: Proposed named OOD-style condition: concatenate eligible guarded segments within each film, correlate separately per native parcel, then equal means over films,parcels and people. Keep any ID Friends concatenation estimator separately named.
primary.rationale: Scores genuine withheld neural responses while respecting stimulus grouping and avoiding TR-rich film or participant domination; source manifest currently has no scorer.

secondary: Per-person and per-film correlation distributions with every native parcel retained.
Neural encoding gain over a fixed nuisance/time encoder and transcript-only reference on identical cases.
Complete coverage, alignment/lag sensitivity and constant/nonfinite prediction diagnostics.

comparators.name: Nuisance/time encoder
comparators.inputs: Predeclared within-segment time and permitted nonsemantic nuisance features
comparators.procedure: Prospective train-only regularized regression; freeze basis,lag and regularization before evaluation.

comparators.name: Transcript-only reference
comparators.inputs: Same permitted transcript embeddings and training BOLD as the legacy narrow condition
comparators.procedure: Prospective fixed reference, with explicit extractor exposure and whole-film split; no score is currently available.

comparators.name: Organizer multimodal encoding baseline
comparators.inputs: Source-permitted audiovisual/language features and training BOLD
comparators.procedure: Pinned organizer implementation is a reference route; authenticate native lags/trims and execute before claiming parity or competence.

nuisance_controls: Group each entire film identity and repeat viewings across participants; enforce temporal/feature-context guards.
Fit scaling,feature compression,hyperparameters and parcel decisions on training data only.
Keep1000 native parcels and distinguish ID from OOD aggregation rather than choosing the more favorable score.
Disclose model/media exposure and public development labels; local target restriction does not make source material unseen.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report all four person values and descriptive paired person summaries; four people do not support precise population inference. Film/block dependence must be retained; no independent-TR or parcel bootstrap.
evaluation.failure_policy: Proposed scorer must require exact participant/film/TR/parcel joins and full predictions, reject nonfinite or undefined-correlation outputs, and retain missing cases as failed coverage. No score is issued by the current producer-only package.
